death.attack.fog_suffocation.player: %1$s drowned in the fog while fleeing %2$s
fogged.configuration.airLossPerTick.tool: Air a player loses per tick, out of 300. Higher = drown faster.
fogged.configuration.allowedMobs.tooltip: Entity-type ids that may live in the murk. The 'minecraft:' namespace may be omitted.
fogged.configuration.debugHud.tooltip: Draw the render state (boundary, fade range, depth capture, hole count) in the corner.
fogged.configuration.debugView.tooltip: Replace the plane with a raw view of one of the buffers behind it.
fogged.configuration.depthScaling.toolti: The murk bites harder the deeper you go: air drains faster and breathing spheres shrink.
How many blocks below the boundary make up one step of scaling. 0 disables it.
fogged.configuration.depthScalingPercent: Per step: air loss up by this percent, nozzle-filter sphere radius down by it. Steps compound.
fogged.configuration.enableExtinguish.to: The murk puts fire out under the boundary: fires vanish, lava freezes, torches fall, and the devices below are unlit and emptied of fuel.
fogged.configuration.enableScour.tooltip: The murk takes things out under the boundary: everything in the list below, broken without drops, and farmland, which reverts and loses what was planted on it.
fogged.configuration.enableTransforms.to: Master switch for the transform list. Off, the murk changes nothing into anything and JEI stops listing the conversions; the list itself is kept.
fogged.configuration.flipFog.tooltip: Put the murk above the boundary instead of below it. Does not move the breathing boundary.
fogged.configuration.foamColor.tooltip: Colour of the foam ring around everything crossing the surface. Alpha scales how strongly it shows.
fogged.configuration.foamWidth.tooltip: How far the foam reaches (in blocks) from every edge. 0 disables it.
fogged.configuration.fogDistance.tooltip: How far you can see (in blocks) once the camera is under the boundary. Lower = denser murk.
fogged.configuration.fogStartRaise.toolt: Where the murk begins, from the plane: above it, 0 at it, or below it.
fogged.configuration.itemTransforms.tool: "from=to" swaps for dropped items, by item id. All of them are listed in JEI.
fogged.configuration.logRenderCompatWarn: Log once when this mod detects it cannot work with the current rendering setup.
Damage dealt each second once the delay is up. 2.0 = one heart.
fogged.configuration.mobSuffocateDelaySe: Seconds a non-allowed mob survives in the murk before it starts taking damage.
fogged.configuration.mobSuffocation.tool: Non-allowed mobs cannot spawn in the murk and take damage once they linger there.
fogged.configuration.overdayOffsetMidnig: Height added to the schedule at midnight -- the high point of the daily rise and fall.
fogged.configuration.overdayOffsetNoon.t: Height added to the schedule at noon -- the low point of the daily rise and fall.
fogged.configuration.planeColor.tooltip: Colour of the murk surface. Its alpha is ignored -- the plane always draws opaque.
fogged.configuration.planeHeightCycle.to: Loop the schedule back and forth instead of holding the last height forever.
fogged.configuration.planeHeightSchedule: One "day=height" entry per line; the boundary eases between them as the days pass.
Dissolve the plane against blocks, mobs and machines instead of cutting them hard at the boundary, and open a soft disc around each entity crossing it. Experimental: it reads the scene's depth buffer, which other rendering mods can move or replace. Turn it off first if the murk looks wrong.
fogged.configuration.playerSuffocation.t: Players drown under the boundary: air drains, then drowning damage.
fogged.configuration.renderPlane.tooltip: Draw the murk surface at the breathing boundary.
fogged.configuration.sableFoam.tooltip: Also ring Sable ships and contraptions with foam. No effect without Sable installed.
fogged.configuration.scouredBlocks.toolt:
Extra blocks the murk breaks under the boundary, on top of the built-in scour. Broken without drops.
One block id per entry; '*' matches any run of characters and a leading '#' names a block tag. 'minecraft:' may be left off.
cobweb
#minecraft:banners
create:*_casing
fogged.configuration.snuffedDevices.tool:
Fire-burning devices the murk puts out: each is unlit, its burn timer zeroed and its fuel ejected, so it cannot keep running under the fog.
One block id per entry; '*' matches any run of characters and 'minecraft:' may be left off. An entry for a mod you do not have is simply ignored.
furnace
create:lit_blaze_burner
simulated:*_portable_engine
fogged.configuration.submergeSkip.toolti: Blocks directly under the plane that the scour leaves alone.
fogged.configuration.submergeWorld.toolt: The murk drowns what is under it: snuffs fires, freezes lava, drowns torches, wilts plants.
fogged.configuration.title: Fogged Configs
fogged.configuration.transforms.tooltip:
What the murk turns things into under the boundary -- placed blocks and dropped stacks alike, from one list.
Syntax: [count] from = [count] to [@depth] [!silent]
from: a block id, an item id, an id with '*' wildcards, or a '#' tag. 'minecraft:' may be left off.
to: one id. A BLOCK replaces a placed block and keeps the properties they share; an ITEM breaks it and drops instead.
count: how many a dropped stack gives up, and how many it gets back. 1 to 64. Counts are about stacks: an entry with one does not touch placed blocks, unless it is the number of items a broken block drops.
@depth: only this far below the surface, in blocks. Moves with the boundary. 0 to 512.
!silent: keep it out of JEI. Everything else is listed there.
coal_ore=stone !silent
moss_block=coarse_dirt @50
4 diamond=2 dirt
#minecraft:leaves=1 stick !silent
create:*_casing=mud @20
fogged.configuration.vaporColorOffsetBlu: Blue added to the plane colour to get the vapour colour.
fogged.configuration.vaporColorOffsetGre: Green added to the plane colour to get the vapour colour.
fogged.configuration.vaporColorOffsetRed: Red added to the plane colour to get the vapour colour.
fogged.configuration.vaporSheets.tooltip: How many mist sheets are stacked over the plane.
fogged.configuration.vaporStrength.toolt: Overall mist alpha. 0 hides the vapour entirely.
fogged.configuration.vaporUnderside.tool: Mirror the mist sheets below the surface too, so the layer reads the same from either side.
fogged.configuration.vaporUnderwater.too: Also draw the mist before the water pass, so a lake veils it instead of it floating on top.
fogged.configuration.vaporUndulation.too: How high (in blocks) the mist sheets rise off the plane. 0 = flat.
fogged.configuration.waterlineCellsPerBl: Cells per block in the foam distance field. Lower is coarser foam and noticeably cheaper.
fogged.tooltip.fog_detector.desc1: Emits a _redstone signal_ by how deep it sits under the fog.
fogged.tooltip.fog_detector.desc2: Right-click with _another_ to stack it taller.
fogged.tooltip.nozzle.desc1: Apply a _Wool Block_ to filter out _thick fog_.
fogged.tooltip.nozzle.desc2: An _Encased Fan's_ speed controls the _breathable area_.
